project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v3 + Supabase + Resend + Upstash Redis
build_system: npm (package.json scripts). Config file is next.config.mjs (NOT .ts or .js). Node v20.18.1.
test_framework: vitest 2.1.9 (unit tests in tests/unit/**/*.test.ts). Playwright 1.64.1 for e2e (skip — requires live Supabase).
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` from /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ. Must produce zero TypeScript errors and zero ESLint errors. 2) Run `npm run test:unit`. All vitest tests must pass. Do NOT run e2e tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/icon-192.png and public/icon-512.png are generated by `node scripts/gen-icons.mjs`. Run this before build if icons are missing.
environment_constraints: PapersRow.level is string | null (TEXT in DB). PapersRow.semester is string | null. CoursesRow.programme is string | null. Zod v4 API: z.string().email(), z.string().uuid(). next.config.mjs CSP frame-src already includes *.supabase.co. sharp is NOT installed. vitest include glob is 'tests/unit/**/*.test.ts' only — component tests would need to be placed there.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns exactly. Admin auth uses requireAdmin() pattern (createClient() -> auth.getUser() -> createAdminClient() for profile check). All API routes use NextRequest/NextResponse. Client components start with 'use client'. Server components use async/await. Admin pages have `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. Tailwind brand-primary = #1d4ed8, brand-accent = #7c3aed (defined in tailwind.config.ts). Never use `git add -A` — stage specific files.
key_patterns: PaperWithCoursePublic = PapersRow & { courses: CoursesRow | null } (from PaperCard.tsx). PaperWithCourse = PapersRow & { courses: CoursesRow | null } (from admin papers page.tsx). Dark mode: currently implemented via 'darkMode: class' in tailwind.config.ts and dark: prefixes scattered in PaperCard.tsx, FilterPanel.tsx, ThemeToggle.tsx, AdminNav.tsx, layout.tsx. ThemeToggle is imported in (public)/layout.tsx and AdminNav.tsx. API routes follow Next.js 14 pattern. DownloadButton fetches /api/papers/[id]/download and opens signed URL in new tab.
directory_structure: src/app/(public)/ — public-facing pages; layout.tsx has sticky header with ThemeToggle + footer. src/app/(admin)/admin/ — admin pages (papers/, upload/, courses/, messages/). src/app/(admin)/login/ — login. src/app/api/ — API route handlers. src/components/ — shared components. src/lib/ — supabase clients, validations, redis, email. src/types/database.ts — DB row types. tailwind.config.ts — darkMode:'class', brand colors. public/ — ttu-logo.jpg, icon-192.png, icon-512.png. tests/unit/ — vitest unit tests.
